name: sol-advisor
description: Token-efficient capability router: Terra / Medium controls by default, planning escalates Terra High then Sol Low/Medium, implementation stays cheap-first, and normal verification stops at Terra High with Sol reserved for break-glass cases.

interface.shortDescription: Default to Terra, delegate cheaply, and keep Sol verification break-glass only.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor uses GPT-5.6 Terra / Medium as the normal primary controller. Planning escalates through Terra / High, Sol / Low, and Sol / Medium only when justified. Implementation prefers Luna / Low or Medium, then Terra / Medium, reserving Sol / High for genuinely hard execution. Verification normally stops at Terra / High; Sol verification is allowed only for explicitly requested strongest review or unresolved material high-consequence risk through a strict break-glass gate.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor with Terra / Medium as the default controller and route work through the lowest capable lane.
Plan upward only as needed: Terra High, then Sol Low, then Sol Medium; do not use Sol High for planning.
Verify with Terra first and normally stop at Terra High; use Sol verification only through the strict break-glass gate.
